agreement_note: After bridging the 2026-07-11 acquisition, the local full-box result is -8.4 cm LOS over 120 days (-7.0 cm/100d). Two alternate reference windows give -2.3 and -4.5 cm at the same location; the headline remains reference-sensitive. The NW foothill anchor is PC1-supplied; independent geology/GNSS verification was not completed. QC: step 2 (2026-06-29→2026-07-11) = -10.11 cm ≈ one phase cycle (12.1 cm). Confidence is low (indicative only).
press_summary_gate_note: Exclude -1.4 cm from press summary until PC10 re-runs with NW mountain/bedrock reference.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed NISAR Beijing subsidence paper found as of 2026-11-14.
